Это два независимых критерия одной и той: These are two independent criteria for the same panel/cabinet. «Panel keywords» decide what counts as a panel on the plan — for placing nodes and as an addressing root (the «Route nodes» and «Node addresses» buttons). «Workset» separately decides the target panels of the «Electrical Equipment» category whose circuits are built and calculated (the «Circuit length» button). An element must meet BOTH criteria, otherwise it may appear on the diagram as a node but drop out of the circuit calculation — or the other way round.
